information: # The competition has been cancelled due to the COVID-19 outbreak. The competition will be held in multiple locations, across the globe. Please pay attention to the **date and time zone** of your location! Locations may be added until the 13th of May 23:59UTC so if there isn't a location near you yet contact your local [Delegate](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/delegates).
